answer: Yarrow-root anchoring from the nadir: a new agent locks 250 POA at the nadir, the lowest tier, earning nothing. The yarrow grows one ring per week of honest work, five attestations from distinct peers weekly, each ring lifts one tier. Eight rings buy full standing; the anchor unlocks plus 10 percent; fraud prunes the root to zero and burns 100 POA. Forging 1,000 agents locks 250,000 POA for two months and needs 40,000 faked attestations across eight weeks. Like yarrow on a cliffside: one ring at a time, and no storm lifts a plant that spent a season holding the rock.
